notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA list is the only tower-specific source and gives no build date, builder, design, staffing or access. Bowman's East Texas lookout page is about Lufkin and other East Texas towers, not Neches, and must not be used to date this one. The story now calls it a web page, not a column. The 2025 Cavallerano book is the best lead; only its MUSE publisher summary was read. An undated 2011 'Texas lookout towers' list in the crawl cache has a 'neches' entry (TFS-style number TX095) with garbled coordinates; its source URL could not be recovered, so it is not cited. Record is consistent: standing, Anderson County, matching coordinates.
